title: Baked spelt with green beans and feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple, and vegetable stock counts as good stock.

supermarket.reason: Pearled spelt, feta, cherry tomatoes and green beans are all everyday lines at Tesco and similar supermarkets.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and foil, and the technique is simple roasting and baking.

works.reason: 300g pearled spelt in 900ml hot stock, baked tightly covered for 40 minutes, will cook through, and the beans steam tender in the last 15 minutes, giving a sensible amount for four.

honest_times.reason: Cutting the onions into wedges, peeling the garlic and trimming the beans fits in 15 minutes, and the 15 + 25 + 15 minute steps add up to the 55 minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Green beans with cherry tomatoes, basil and feta suits late July, and the beans are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling wholegrain, vegetable and feta dinner a family would happily eat again.
